en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5461 - Hammad ibn ʿIsa narrated from Hariz from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Abdullah (as)
regarding a man who made a will in the presence of his heirs, and they approved it. However, after the man's death, they attempted to revoke the will.
Imam (as) said: "They do not have the right to revoke it. The will remains binding upon them once they had approved it during his lifetime."
